description: estimates remaining confirmation time from caller-supplied block cadence using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded base confirmation eta result before signing, submitting, replacing, or accepting an EVM/Base transaction assembled from caller-owned data. Returns normalized transaction evidence, calculated budget or shape findings, and a fail-closed preflight status for Base Confirmation Eta as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Uses caller-supplied values only; it performs no RPC call, signing, broadcasting, balance lookup, custody, trading, or live-chain claim.

assumed_block_seconds.description: Assumed Block Seconds supplied to Base Confirmation Eta; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

current_confirmations.description: Current Confirmations supplied to Base Confirmation Eta; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

required_confirmations.description: Required Confirmations supplied to Base Confirmation Eta; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

name: util_base_confirmation_eta
